title: 駐車場の精算機
description: 時間貸し駐車場に置く、ひさし付きの料金精算機です。コンクリートの島、紺色の本体、発光する無地のヘッダー、ステンレスの前面とひさし、液晶画面と押しボタン、駐車券・硬貨・紙幣・カードの投入口、インターホン、つり銭受け、両脇の黄色い防護柱を造形しています。料金・案内の文字、画面表示、決済や通話の機能は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.900 × 1.620 × 0.700 m、2,884三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A canopied pay station for pay-by-time car parks. It models the concrete island, navy body, a lit blank header, stainless front panel and canopy, LCD screen and buttons, ticket, coin, note and card slots, intercom grille, change tray and two yellow guard posts. Prices, instructions and other text, on-screen content and payment or intercom function are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.900 × 1.620 × 0.700 m; 2,884 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
